question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Full query: Top 3 revenue-generating films per actor, with average revenue per actor
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.film_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_actor_count AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(actor_id) AS actor_count
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        fr.total_revenue AS film_total_revenue,
        fr.total_revenue * 1.0 / fac.actor_count AS revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN film_actor_count fac ON fa.film_id = fac.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        f.title,
        ROUND(af.film_total_revenue, 2) AS film_revenue,
        ROUND(af.revenue_per_actor, 2) AS revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.actor_id ORDER BY af.revenue_per_actor DESC, af.film_id) AS rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue af
    JOIN actor a ON af.actor_id = a.actor_id
    JOIN film f ON af.film_id = f.film_id
)
SELECT 
    actor_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    title,
    film_revenue,
    revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, rn;
